observation.command:
export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH" && cd /workspace && for d in 02-backend/*/ 03-shared-services/*/; do
  n=$(basename "$d")
  # demospipes root and demosplan have no pyproject; skip
  [ -f "$d/pyproject.toml" ] || { echo "SKIP $d (no pyproject)"; continue; }
  ( cd "$d" && timeout 300 uv lock >/tmp/lock_$n.log 2>&1 && echo "LOCKED $d" || echo "FAILED $d" )
done
